article_limitations: Cross-sectional series of 23 patients (31 eyes) with Eales disease; only the 16 patients with macular involvement in Table 6 are individually described, so the roster is incomplete (23 reported, 16 individuated). The other 7 patients have no individual data.

Table 6 rows carry no eye, laterality, time point or units (BCVA, CMT); the study counts eyes (31) and patients (23) and the row unit is not clearly stated. BCVA and CMT units are not printed in the cells and none was added.

Cohort counts do not match Table 6: Table 2 and the text report macular changes on FA in 13 of 16 (FA missed 3) and on OCT and OCTA in 100%, but Table 4 (FA 10, OCT 13, OCTA 12 involved) and the 13 within-normal-limit Table 6 cells imply FA missed 6, OCT 3 and OCTA 4. This is a count mismatch (ambiguity); the Table 6 cells are kept as included per-patient results.

Family history of tuberculosis is stated as 7 patients (35%) in the text but 7 patients (30.4%) in Table 1; both are cohort statements and are not copied to individuals. Known tuberculosis (3 patients) and the stage counts of Table 3 are likewise cohort-level and not assigned to patients.

Figures 2 to 5 depict unnamed patients by age and sex only (36, 17, 23 and 22 years, all male). Table 6 rows with matching age are attribute matches, not literal links (two rows share each of the last three ages), so figure ownership is unresolved and no caption vision or finding is attached to a patient; Figure 2 (36 years, FTMH) matches Table 6 row 10 only by attributes.

Unlabelled discussion statements about individual patients (for example a patient with unexplained loss of vision with normal SLB and FA, or DCP enlargement disproportionate to SCP in 8 patients) are not assigned to any Table 6 patient.
